summary.text: Ranjeev Puri is the Democratic state representative for Michigan House District 24, which he has held since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia says he was selected as House minority leader effective January 15, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Ranjeev Puri was born in Racine, Wisconsin, according to Ballotpedia, and earned a bachelor's degree in economics and finance from Ohio State University and a master's degree from the University of Chicago in 2014.
His career experience includes working as a business manager with Fiat Chrysler Automobiles.
He has volunteered with South Asians of Michigan Organizing for Serious Actions, Moms Demand Action, the Arts and Partnership Board Canton and the Sikh Gurdwara of Canton.
Puri was assigned to the House Appropriations Committee in 2023-2024.
